mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.login_id, p.name, p.phone_enc, p.postal_code, p.address, p.detail_address FROM users u INNER JOIN user_profiles p ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (user_id, login_id, password_hash, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{loginId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{passwordHash, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})

INSERT INTO user_profiles ( user_id, name, resident_number_enc, resident_number_hash, gender, postal_code, address, detail_address, phone_enc, phone_hash, emergency_contact_phone_enc, emergency_contact_phone_hash, emergency_contact_name, emergency_contact_relationship, created_at ) VALUES ( #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{residentNumberEncrypted, jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{residentNumberHash, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{gender, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{postalCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{address, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{detailAddress, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{phoneEncrypted, jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{phoneHash, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{emergencyContactPhoneEncrypted, jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{emergencyContactPhoneHash, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{emergencyContactName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{emergencyContactRelationship, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )

INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (refresh_token_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, created_at) VALUES (#{refreshTokenId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{tokenHash, jdbcType=CHAR}, #{expiresAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{createdAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT refresh_token_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, revoked_reason, replaced_by_token_id, last_used_at, created_at FROM refresh_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash, jdbcType=CHAR}
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, revoked_reason = 'ROTATED', replaced_by_token_id = #{replacedByTokenId, jdbcType=CHAR}, last_used_at = #{revokedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE refresh_token_id = #{refreshTokenId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_tokens SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, revoked_reason = 'LOGOUT' WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash, jdbcType=CHAR} AND revoked_at IS NULL
